module.name: Install F5SPKVlan + GatewayClass
module.description: Cloud-agnostic primitive: apply F5SPKVlan and GatewayClass custom resources for the BNK host-device data-plane pattern. F5SPKVlan binds TMM trunks to named VLANs with SelfIPs; GatewayClass registers the cne-controller as a Gateway API implementation. SelfIP values are cloud-specific inputs (e.g. AWS ENI secondary IPs). Matches awsbnkctl Phase 23b.

required.reason: Hugepages must be configured on BNK nodes before TMM can schedule; this module runs after CNEInstance reaches Reconciled which requires hugepages.

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Logical name of the BNK cluster. Used to derive the GatewayClass CR name (<cluster_name>-gatewayclass). Supplied by the per-cloud wrapper module from its cluster identity output.

required.name: tmm_ext_selfip
required.description: SelfIP address for the external TMM VLAN (trunk 1.1). Cloud-specific: on AWS, a secondary private IP on the external ENI derived from the external data-plane subnet. Supplied by the per-cloud wrapper module.

optional.name: instance_namespace
optional.description: Kubernetes namespace for CNEInstance and F5SPKVlan CRs. Default: f5-cne-system.

optional.name: tmm_int_selfip
optional.description: SelfIP for the internal TMM VLAN (trunk 1.2). Required when has_internal_interface=true. Cloud-specific secondary IP on the internal host interface.

optional.name: tmm_selfip_prefixlen
optional.description: IPv4 prefix length for both SelfIPs (e.g. 24 for /24). Must match the data-plane subnet prefix length.

optional.name: has_internal_interface
optional.description: When true, apply the int-vlan F5SPKVlan CR (dual-interface TMM pattern).

optional.name: gatewayclass_name
optional.description: GatewayClass CR name. Empty = auto-derive as <cluster_name>-gatewayclass.

optional.name: crd_wait_timeout
optional.description: kubectl wait timeout for F5SPKVlan + GatewayClass CRDs to be Established. FLO installs these CRDs after CNEInstance reconciles (can take 10+ min on cold cluster).

key_outputs.name: gatewayclass_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the GatewayClass CR applied. Operator Gateway CRs must reference this via .spec.gatewayClassName.

key_outputs.name: f5spkvlan_ext_applied
key_outputs.description: True once the ext-vlan F5SPKVlan CR has been applied.

key_outputs.name: spkvlan_gatewayclass_ready
key_outputs.description: Gate output — true once both F5SPKVlan and GatewayClass CRs are applied. Downstream Gateway CRs and traffic steps depend on this.
